title: Orthogonal residual against a finite family: a − Σ c_l w_l is orthogonal to every w_j and has norm ≤ ‖a‖
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and w = (w_0, …, w_{k−1}) with every w_i ∈ ℝ^P (no linear independence assumed). Then there exist c_0, …, c_{k−1} ∈ ℝ such that a' := a − Σ_{l<k} c_l w_l satisfies ⟨a', w_j⟩ = 0 for every j < k, and ‖a'‖ ≤ ‖a‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P), ∃ c : Fin k → ℝ, (∀ j : Fin k, inner ℝ (a - ∑ l, c l • w l) (w j) = 0) ∧ ‖a - ∑ l, c l • w l‖ ≤ ‖a‖
